RHSO Rust third-party license and copyright collection
=====================================================
Dependency input: Cargo.lock
Cargo.lock SHA-256: 5f1905025bdc751b73b706f1ae51a0ddf25eaadf3525d8e89eae78a9c991f45a
Third-party package/version count: 156
Source notice file count: 298

Scope: locked offline Cargo trees with default features and normal/build edges
for Android arm64 backend, wasm32 browser controller and Windows x64 packager.
Build scripts, host proc macros, code generation and packaging dependencies are
included conservatively. This inventory does not prove every listed component,
license alternative or platform-specific file is linked into Android or WASM.
Dev-only, disabled optional and unrelated target packages outside these graphs
are excluded. Original project, Rust standard library, KernelSU SDK and Android
NDK notices remain in their separate module license files.

Every cached manifest and included notice was compared byte-for-byte to its
locked crates.io archive, whose SHA-256 matches Cargo.lock. asn1-rs-impl 0.2.0
omits license files in that archive: its two actual license texts were retrieved
from the recorded exact upstream VCS commit; URLs and hashes appear below.
No license text is inferred from SPDX. Upstream wording and line layout are retained;
UTF-8, LF newlines and trailing whitespace are normalized, including nested notices and copyright files. Offered
license alternatives are retained without selecting a license for an author.
